tools.name: web_crawl
tools.description: Traverse linked pages starting from one seed URL.

render.description: Optional JavaScript rendering mode for the final page read. auto uses declared agent-readable sources first and renders when needed; off forbids browser rendering; required fails if the rendered DOM cannot be obtained.

retrieval_effort.description: Optional retrieval effort for semantic extraction and internal escalation. This is not a result count, page count, crawl depth, or candidate limit. Omit it for standard behavior.

tools.name: web_query
tools.description: Plan and execute a goal-oriented query from a seed URL. Use same_site_links to expand from a seed site, and off only when seed_url is the exact canonical page. Seedless web_search is experimental, explicit opt-in, and must never be selected automatically.

examples.goal: Read the verified initialize method page

discovery_mode.description: Discovery strategy. same_site_links = follow links from the seed site. off = do not expand beyond an exact verified seed URL. web_search = EXPERIMENTAL seedless public bootstrap and must be selected explicitly when seed_url is omitted; never choose it automatically.

goal.description: Retrieval objective or question to answer.

render.description: Optional JavaScript rendering mode for the final page read. auto uses declared agent-readable sources first and renders when needed; off forbids browser rendering; required fails if the rendered DOM cannot be obtained.

retrieval_effort.description: Optional retrieval effort for semantic extraction and internal escalation. This is not a result count, page count, crawl depth, or candidate limit. Omit it for standard behavior.

seed_url.description: Starting URL for stable use. same_site_links expands from this site. When discovery_mode=off, this must be the exact canonical page and must already exist. Omit only for explicit experimental web_search.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Read one known URL and return compact proof-carrying context first. Successful reads preserve proof, trace, local reuse evidence, and analytics metadata.

render.description: Optional JavaScript rendering mode for the final page read. auto uses declared agent-readable sources first and renders when needed; off forbids browser rendering; required fails if the rendered DOM cannot be obtained.

retrieval_effort.description: Optional retrieval effort for semantic extraction and internal escalation. This is not a result count, page count, crawl depth, or candidate limit. Omit it for standard behavior.

tools.name: web_replay
tools.description: Replay a stored trace and report deterministic stage completion.

tools.name: web_diff
tools.description: Compare two stored traces and report changed stages.

tools.name: web_proof
tools.description: Load proof records by trace id, proof id, or chunk id.

tools.name: web_prune
tools.description: Operator maintenance. Prune local traces/proofs/fingerprints/genome files, or set embedding_cache=true to dry-run/remove disposable PAL embedding cache files.

dry_run.description: When used with embedding_cache=true, report matching/reclaimable files without deleting them.

embedding_cache.description: When true, target only PAL embedding cache files under NEEDLEX_HOME/data/embeddings/cache.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Advanced non-core Discovery Memory control. Use only when explicitly inspecting or maintaining Needle-X local semantic memory; normal web retrieval already uses memory automatically. Actions: stats shows counts/freshness; search checks local semantic recall; prune applies retention policy; export/import move canonical JSONL rows; rebuild_index refreshes acceleration state and can force semantic re-embedding.

action.description: Required operation. Prefer stats or search for debugging; prune/export/import/rebuild_index are maintenance actions.

force_embeddings.description: For action=rebuild_index only: recompute memory embeddings before rebuilding acceleration state.

tools.name: analytics
tools.description: Advanced non-core Analytics PAL control. Use only for diagnostics, value reporting, or maintenance; normal web_read/web_query/web_crawl record analytics automatically. Actions: value_report is the user-facing WOW report; stats/recent_runs are quick diagnostics; hosts/providers/failures/daily are maintainer rollups; export writes full analytics artifacts.

action.description: Required operation. Prefer value_report for product value, stats/recent_runs for quick debug, failures/providers for reliability analysis.

limit.description: Maximum rows for recent_runs, hosts, providers, failures, or daily.
